item.title: Opinion: Europe's summer of heat
item.description: Europe is in another brutal heat wave. The summer's earlier record-breaking weather already damaged crops, sparked wildfires and led to increased deaths.

item.title: Switzerland is a neutral nation but has more nuclear bunkers than any country in the world
item.description: Instead of scrapping its network of bomb shelters after the Cold War, Switzerland kept building them. The country has more than 370,000 nuclear bomb shelters. Some are now used to house migrants.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Federal funds can't be used to give test strips to drug users, raising overdose fears
item.description: Drug addiction groups are reeling after Trump officials said federal grants cannot be used to hand out test strips to drug users. The strips help users check street drugs for dangerous adulterants.

item.title: Women in Maine may choose the victor in this year's Senate race
item.description: The race between Susan Collins and Troy Jackson is one of the nation's most high-profile Senate contests this year -- and may ultimately be decided by an especially powerful voting bloc: Maine women.
